_doc: Long 16:9 Track Pacing Standard v4.0 (strictly widescreen 1920x1080, 6.5-15.0 min, sequential Episodic Units U1..Uk). Shares empirically calibrated v4.0 Hai Dang voice (4.55-4.62 overall wps, pitch 1.00) so long episodes never drag or rush.

voice._why: Same empirically calibrated v4.0 Hai Dang rhythm as Short track; CI rejects sluggish <4.40 wps and rushed >4.74 wps.
